title: Subextensive squared-amplitude mass cannot lower the leading coefficient

scale_bound.profile: Known nonnegative weights satisfy 0<=rho_(N,k)<=rho_+ on the complete d_N=Theta(N^3) cube; put B_N=sum rho_k^2.
scale_bound.defect_floor: K1661 and Cauchy give D_(M,N)>=-3eta^2 d_N B_N/N^2, including zero weights.
scale_bound.full_gap: K1637 gives Q_N-lambda_N^statG=A_N+R_(Omega,N)/4+gD_(M,N), with A_N and R_(Omega,N) nonnegative.
scale_bound.coefficient_result: If B_N=o(N^3), then Q_N-lambda_N^statG>=-o(N^4), so the family cannot produce a strict negative order-N^4 descent or lower the leading coefficient.
scale_bound.scope_guard: This is one-sided coefficient-lowering inertia, not a two-sided o(N^4) gap estimate, positive gap, localization theorem or unrestricted coercivity theorem.
